title: Validate EU VAT number with VIES at checkout
description: On "Place order", the VAT number field is checked against the EU VIES service (no API key needed). An invalid number blocks the order with an error; if VIES is unreachable the order goes through. Set the checkout field name in the variable (the field itself must already exist).

variables.name: vat_field
variables.label: VAT number field name
variables.description: Checkout field that holds the VAT number, e.g. billing_vat
